authority: Editorial craft owned by the editorial agent under author delegation. Canon and claim content remain author decisions.

ledgerSearch.outcome: CTD-0049 tracks the Volume VIII forward door and is satisfied by naming the eighth volume as forthcoming rather than as delivered. CTD-0081 governs Saturn only where the planetary scheme is offered as evidence, which it is not here. Nothing in the ledger governs the six volume summaries, so the baseline is the authority on them.

substitutionCheck: Grepped. The third proposed Providence as coordination infrastructure and compressed the architecture into a nest small enough to carry are both absent from the baseline. The recapitulation was rewritten from the other volumes, not compressed from this one.

findings.summary: Six volume summaries, each a full paragraph with its own image and its own reason, were replaced by six clauses in one sentence.

evidence.baseline: In the first volume we laid the ground ... In the fifth we returned the whole measure to the human, bringing the argument home to the one who must live it, not a principle in the abstract but a person in a body, on a morning, with a life to conduct. And in the sixth we did the quietest and hardest thing of all: we reduced it.
evidence.shipped: The first volume named the difference between coherent and extractive foundations. The second located intelligence in relation. The third proposed Providence as coordination infrastructure. The fourth tested that proposal against structure. The fifth returned purpose to the person who must live it. The sixth compressed the architecture into a nest small enough to carry.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and catalog 4.4 plausibly applied to the six parallel paragraph openings.
findings.diagnosis: The paragraphs are anaphoric by design and the card lists ritual repetition among the volume protections, so 4.4 fires on its retention limb. Each paragraph also carries a reason the clause version drops: why form is needed, why elegance is truth with waste removed, why the human had to be returned to. The replacement is not shorter prose about the same thing, it is a table of contents. Two of its six clauses also describe volumes differently than those volumes describe themselves.

findings.summary: The opening image of an argument turning to regard itself was replaced by a statement of what the volumes did.

evidence.baseline: There comes a point in any patient work when the argument, having been carried forward piece by piece, turns and regards itself, and finds that it was never a sequence of claims but a single living thing, growing.
evidence.shipped: The first six volumes moved from substrate to relation, architecture, human purpose, and the smallest form that could hold the whole.

findings.diagnosis: The section is called The Argument, Arrived, and the baseline opening is the arrival. Without it the title has no referent. The card names the threshold as a signature image of this volume, and an argument turning to look at itself is a threshold.

findings.summary: The account of the eighth volume lost Saturn as lord of limits and lost the reason a spiritual volume needs a counterweight.

evidence.baseline: Saturn is the lord of limits and of time, the keeper of boundaries and the weigher of what is owed ... a civilization is made durable not by inspiration but by what it is willing to face in the dark, and by the discipline of building within real and unforgiving constraint.
evidence.shipped: Volume VIII will answer with Saturn’s accounting: limits, consequences, and the evidence spiritual ardor may prefer to skip.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and CTD-0081 possibly read as forbidding all planetary language.
findings.diagnosis: CTD-0081 forbids treating the planetary scheme as evidence. It does not forbid the figure. Saturn here is doing argumentative work: it names why the ardor of this volume must be followed by an accounting, which is the sentence that makes Volume VIII necessary rather than merely next. The item is honoured by the disclaimer in Part II, not by deleting the image.

findings.summary: The closing statement of what the volume is was cut.

evidence.baseline: the hinge between the inward work of becoming and the outward work of building

findings.authorizedBy: Catalog 4.23, meta claims about the text.
findings.diagnosis: 4.23 keeps genuine wayfinding in a long philosophical work. A seven volume argument naming which joint the seventh volume occupies is wayfinding of the most useful kind, and hinge is the exact word: this is the only volume that faces both directions.

debtImpact.note: Volume VIII is still named as forthcoming rather than as available. The forward door remains a promise the corpus tracks.
Saturn returns as a figure. The evidentiary framing the item names lives in Part II, and it is not restored there.

generations.title: Derived from baseline under the thirteen rules

reasoning.note: R-PUNCT-STRUCT. Nine em dashes. Four introduced a specification and became colons. Three separated a second movement and became periods, which is what the mark was doing in each case. Two set off an appositive around this one and became commas, the only place a comma was the right repair.

R-LAND on the eighth volume paragraph. The baseline runs the counterweight claim into a trailing for clause. Promoted to its own sentence so the paragraph lands on constraint rather than on a qualification.
The prior pass sentence naming Volume IX, which the baseline defers to Part II. It costs one sentence and completes the forward look.
The opening image, all six volume paragraphs, the Saturn account, the counterweight reasoning, and the hinge close.

openQuestions.question: The restored text says the eighth volume will render accounts that spirit alone is always tempted to skip. That is a claim about the seventh volume as much as the eighth. Does the author want it in Volume VII’s own voice, or moved into Volume VIII?

regenerationTest.purpose: The rules must reproduce the section from the baseline without consulting the stored text.
regenerationTest.method: Derived from the immutable baseline applying editorial/method/standard.md, the volume-07 voice card, editorial/sources/corpus/voice-card.md, and the debt ledger under R-LEDGER-WINS.
regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. The case worth keeping is the Saturn finding: a ledger item that forbids a use of a figure was read by the prior pass as forbidding the figure, which cost the section its argument for why Volume VIII exists.
